title: Iterated Dynamic-Programming Update
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean choices, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,V,t\in\mathbb N$. Applying the dynamic-programming update $t$ times to the pairing of the context for $x,s,V$ and the initial encoded value vector gives the pairing of that same context with the encoded vector of dynamic-programming values at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
